name: comp-439

frames.best_why: Shows all three count circles and labels with Overview selected and its caption in view.

tagline: Counts ride above the labels in a row of tabs that swap the caption.
summary: A row of three tabs, each a small pale number circle over a short label, where the chosen tab gains a soft rounded panel and changes the note beneath.
appearance: Three equal columns stretch across a dark strip, each holding a small grey circle with a count above a short label. The selected column is wrapped in a soft rounded rectangle; a centred muted caption sits below the row.
behaviour: Clicking a column slides the rounded panel onto it and swaps the caption underneath. The count circles of the other tabs fade to about half opacity.
demo_content: Overview 3, Projects 0, Packages 7, with captions about updates, no projects and published packages.
search_phrases: big number tabs for a dashboard
three cards with numbers to pick from
use_when: Choosing between a few inbox or dashboard sections where each total should be readable at a glance.
avoid_when: When counts are live: the three numbers and captions are hardcoded, not bound to real data.
customise: Counts, labels and captions are written inside the file, so changing them means editing the tabs. The selected panel colour and circle size come from classes.
weight_why: Three labelled tabs and tiny badges; only opacity and background transitions run.

a11y.note: Each tab reads as its number plus label to screen readers; the circles carry no extra description and there is no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The root is locked to a 320px width, so it will not stretch to a wider container.
polish_why: Even columns and tidy count circles, but the panel is mostly empty around a single caption line.
title: Badged Count Tabs
